title.en: EVE Academy – Invention and Tech 2 Production

blocks.en: ﻿Behind every great Fleet Commander in New Eden
blocks.zh: 新伊甸每一位伟大的舰队指挥背后，

blocks.en: is a chain of industrialists working to produce their ships.
blocks.zh: 都有一串工业玩家在为他们生产舰船。

blocks.en: Every massive war or fleet fight relies on production of vital Tech 2 equipment.
blocks.zh: 每一场大战或舰队战，都依赖于关键 T2 装备的生产。

blocks.en: Bolstering the front lines through the invention of Tech 2 blueprints is a highly desired skill
blocks.zh: 通过发明 T2 蓝图来支援前线，是一项备受追捧的技能，

blocks.en: which can be very rewarding to specialize in.
blocks.zh: 专精于此可以获得丰厚的回报。

blocks.en: To get started with the production of Tech 2 equipment,
blocks.zh: 要开始生产 T2 装备，

blocks.en: you'll first need to use the industry window to invent the blueprint.
blocks.zh: 首先需要在工业窗口中发明蓝图。

blocks.en: Nearly all Tech 2 blueprints come from a blueprint copy of their Tech 1 variant.
blocks.zh: 几乎所有 T2 蓝图都来自其 T1 版本的蓝图拷贝。

blocks.en: A Tech 2 Acolyte drone, for example, can be invented using a Blueprint Copy
blocks.zh: 例如，T2 的侍僧无人机（Acolyte II）可以用

blocks.en: of the Tech 1 Acolyte drone.
blocks.zh: T1 侍僧无人机的蓝图拷贝发明出来。

blocks.en: This upgraded version is usually better in every way
blocks.zh: 这种升级版通常在各方面都更好，

blocks.en: and will fetch a higher price on the market.
blocks.zh: 在市场上也能卖出更高的价格。

blocks.en: As with any other area of industry, invention requires a certain set of skills.
blocks.zh: 和工业的其他领域一样，发明也需要一系列技能。

blocks.en: You can see what's needed by right clicking on your blueprint copy,
blocks.zh: 右键点击你的蓝图拷贝，

blocks.en: choosing "Show info", and then looking at the invention section.
blocks.zh: 选择「显示信息」，然后查看发明部分，就能看到所需技能。

blocks.en: The skills required for invention and Tech 2 production can be quite high,
blocks.zh: 发明和 T2 生产所需的技能要求可能相当高，

blocks.en: but it is a valuable investment for the aspiring industrialist.
blocks.zh: 但对有志于工业的玩家来说，这是一项值得的投资。

blocks.en: Remember that a blueprint copy is created from a blueprint original.
blocks.zh: 记住，蓝图拷贝是由蓝图原件复制出来的。

blocks.en: The Material and Time Efficiency of the copy will not matter for the process of invention,
blocks.zh: 拷贝的材料效率和时间效率对发明过程没有影响，

blocks.en: but the copy will be used up in the process!
blocks.zh: 但拷贝会在过程中被消耗掉！

blocks.en: Once your blueprint copy is ready, drop it into the Industry window
blocks.zh: 准备好蓝图拷贝后，把它拖进工业窗口，

blocks.en: and click the Invention button.
blocks.zh: 点击「发明（Invention）」按钮。

blocks.en: The left side of the window shows your input.
blocks.zh: 窗口左侧显示你的投入。

blocks.en: For invention, this uses datacores found in data sites,
blocks.zh: 发明需要使用在数据站点中找到的数据核心，

blocks.en: and the right side shows your output.
blocks.zh: 右侧则显示你的产出。

blocks.en: Invention only has a limited chance of succeeding
blocks.zh: 发明只有一定的几率

blocks.en: in creating the T2 blueprint copy.
blocks.zh: 成功制造出 T2 蓝图拷贝。

blocks.en: You can see the likelihood of success next to the output.
blocks.zh: 产出旁边会显示成功几率。

blocks.en: To see which skills affect your chances you can hover over the number.
blocks.zh: 将鼠标悬停在这个数字上，可以查看哪些技能会影响成功率。

blocks.en: In addition to the required datacores, you will also see a slot for decryptors,
blocks.zh: 除了所需的数据核心，你还会看到一个解码器槽位，

blocks.en: which can be used to improve the outcome of the invention process in various ways.
blocks.zh: 解码器能以各种方式改善发明结果。

blocks.en: These are optional input items that come in many varieties.
blocks.zh: 它们是可选的投入物品，种类繁多。

blocks.en: Some may improve your chance of a successful outcome,
blocks.zh: 有些能提高成功几率，

blocks.en: whereas others may lower your chances
blocks.zh: 有些则会降低成功率，

blocks.en: while offering a more efficient blueprint if the job succeeds.
blocks.zh: 但在工作成功时提供效率更高的蓝图。

blocks.en: You can click to bring up the decryptor menu
blocks.zh: 你可以点击打开解码器菜单，

blocks.en: and try them out before committing to the invention process.
blocks.zh: 在正式开始发明之前逐个试试看。

blocks.en: When you're ready, start the job!
blocks.zh: 准备好后，就开始工作吧！

blocks.en: As with any industry job, you will need to wait for the process to finish.
blocks.zh: 和其他工业工作一样，你需要等待流程完成。

blocks.en: If your invention is successful, you'll receive a limited-run Tech 2 BPC,
blocks.zh: 如果发明成功，你会得到一份流程数有限的 T2 蓝图拷贝，

blocks.en: which can be used to make Tech 2 items!
blocks.zh: 可以用来制造 T2 物品！

blocks.en: Note the different categories of items which go into the new T2 item.
blocks.zh: 注意新 T2 物品所需的各类材料。

blocks.en: Building Tech 2 items requires a wide variety of ingredients,
blocks.zh: 制造 T2 物品需要各种各样的原料，

blocks.en: including moon materials, minerals, a Tech 1 version of the item,
blocks.zh: 包括卫星原料、矿物、该物品的 T1 版本，

blocks.en: and components produced from planetary industry.
blocks.zh: 以及行星开发生产的部件。

blocks.en: If you have the capacity, you can attempt to gather all of these yourself,
blocks.zh: 如果你有能力，可以尝试自己采集所有这些材料，

blocks.en: however it will take a lot of work.
blocks.zh: 不过工作量会非常大。

blocks.en: You can instead buy the necessary components off the market.
blocks.zh: 你也可以直接从市场上购买所需部件。

blocks.en: Much like T1 manufacturing, just combine all the required materials
blocks.zh: 和 T1 制造一样，只要备齐所有所需材料，

blocks.en: and start the job to make the item!
blocks.zh: 开始工作就能制造出物品！

blocks.en: Knowing how to complete your first invention job
blocks.zh: 学会完成你的第一项发明工作，

blocks.en: is just the tip of the iceberg in industry.
blocks.zh: 只是工业领域的冰山一角。

blocks.en: Keep building and you'll have the start of an industrial empire before you know it!
blocks.zh: 继续制造吧，不知不觉中你就会打下工业帝国的根基！
